_doc: Home templates of the residential districts (Docs/Locations/Plan_ResidentialDistricts.md). Factions built from these are NEVER listed in initializeFactions: ResidenceUtility.CreateResidence instantiates one per generated home under a new ID (<districtID>_res_<n>) and links its mainExit room (or the district entry's linkRoomID) to a district attach room with a runtime RoomDoor. isPublic false + showLockedFloors true = the player sees the home's floor button but its rooms (requireFactionMembership on the floor plan) only open to residents, visit passes (GrantVisitAccess), bookings there and the player's followers. A generated home is named after its leader by AssignResidence; nameOverwrite below is only the placeholder until then. Meals: a non-player faction hands out a fresh copy of an inventory item without depleting stock, so one bento covers every meal at furniture_marker_getmeal (hospital pattern).

factionInit._comment_isRentingFloor: apartment units are leased (floor_res_apt_2ldk wholeBuildingRent), unspecified landlord

factionInit._comment: Detached 4LDK house on the existing house_floor_4ldk (shared with the existing households, not edited: its rooms carry no requireFactionMembership - a generated home locks all its rooms anyway, Room_Instance.CanBeAccessedBy). 4 bedrooms, one with a double bed for the leader.
